rows.what_the_ink_shows: The scan is a handwritten sheet with freehand geometric drawings and handwritten mathematical labels, numbered 29 in its lower-left corner. The circled definition visibly contains sigma(V)=sigma(U) intersect R^n and a family of pairs (sigma_i,(U_i,V_i)) (crops/8_scan030_L742_chart_definition.jpg). The central list reads Familles connexes, Familles régulières (quasi-régulières), Familles naturelles, and Familles normales, with C^r and differentiability bounds (crops/8_scan030_L742_family_classes.jpg). The lower half of the full scan has two overlapping chart diagrams, labels U_1,U_2,V_1,V_2 and sigma_1,sigma_2, and intersection conditions. There is no typeset prose, Tribu title, Bourbaki redaction identification, or catalogue of scan numbers on this page; none of the disputed catalogue wording occurs in page.tex.
rows.note: Decision d applies to the external catalogue attribution and range quoted by the row, which have no locus in this page transcription. The supplied correction specifically describes 8:30 as a handwritten sheet on chart families, and direct inspection positively confirms that local description. The existing TeX already records the family classes and chart drawings without the disputed Tribu attribution. Preserve all bytes. I did not inspect the other listed scans or independently verify their Bourbaki/Tribu/other attributions, typed page numbers, or ranges, and this page does not identify an alternative location for the catalogue wording. The separate page reports and named crops document these local identifications. This does not verify the unsupplied intervening leaves or every bibliographic attribution in the proposed range.
